title: Access new inventory and channel performance reporting in Performance Max campaigns - Google Ads Help - Accelerate with Google US

facts.fact: The Google Ads announcement page 'Access new inventory and channel performance reporting in Performance Max campaigns' was published on 2025-11-06.
Google's account-creation prompt states that multiple campaigns can be created within the same Google Ads account without creating a new account.
facts.quote: You can create multiple campaigns in the same account without creating a new account.

facts.fact: Waze ads inventory was added to Performance Max for store goals campaigns, where a business can appear as a 'Promoted Places in Navigation' pin on a user's map.
facts.quote: We’re making it easier for you to reach customers on the go by adding Waze ads inventory to

facts.fact: For U.S. advertisers using Performance Max for store goals, Waze ads are fully available and require no additional setup, as Performance Max uses existing assets to optimize for Store Visits, Store Sales, or Local Actions Directions.
Google plans to expand Waze inventory for Performance Max to markets beyond the U.S. in 2026.
facts.quote: We are planning to expand Waze inventory to additional markets beyond the U.S. in 2026.

facts.fact: Channel performance reporting is now available in all Performance Max campaigns.
facts.quote: is now available in all Performance Max campaigns, giving you more insight into where your ads are running.

facts.fact: In the coming weeks, advertisers will be able to get specific reporting on search partners and access the channel performance report via manager accounts (MCC), according to Google.
facts.quote: In the coming weeks, you’ll also be able to get specific reporting on search partners

facts.fact: Google says it launched several Performance Max channel performance improvements in September 2025, including bulk reporting and download and the ability to segment results.
facts.quote: several improvements in September as well, including bulk reporting and download, the ability to segment results, and more.
